text_block_list.text:
Сайленс Судзука performs incredibly at
the Yayoi
Sho.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
However, seeing the other racers cry in
frustration
at their losses causes her to
question her reason
for running.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Worried she won't be able to stay
focused or run
well in her distracted
state, she requests to
withdraw from the
upcoming Satsuki Sho.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
However, knowing it's no good to
continue
without a goal on the books, I
decide to enter her
in the Kobe Shimbun
Hai.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
